8184.title: Markdown parser work is repeated after component remount
8184.rootCauseOneLine: MarkdownPreview owns its piece cache in component state; remounting discards it and runs the real remark parser again for identical source.

prReviews.verdict: STATIC ONLY — targets the verified cache-lifetime cause
prReviews.topFinding: PR code was not run; a new fix would duplicate this open PR.

8184.proposedFix: Bound and reuse parser-stage trees across mounts, include syntax configuration in keys, and isolate mutable transforms and mount-specific rendering.
8184.caveats: Repeated by the same agent in two clean checkouts; production browser timing claims were not remeasured. No duplicate fix because PR #8185 is open.
